title: Textarea
description: The Textarea component is based on the native HTML textarea element and it has access to the Form handler functions and utilities. It should be used as a child in Form component

props.name: validation
props.description: Overrides the native validityState error messages

props.name: label
props.description: Label of the textarea field. Recommended for accessibility

props.name: classes
props.type: { field: string; label: string; error: string; }
props.description: Classes applied to the textarea, label and error elements
